# examples/calendar/weekview throws on load and renders nothing

**Claim it first:** comment on this issue before you start, and check the open pull requests for one that already points here. We merge the first approve-worthy PR (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`, point 3). This row comes from #19920: @bercedev has first pick on its rows, and @kaushlendra-pt-singh asked for this one there, so it is theirs if @bercedev passes.

## Context

Welcome! This is one row of #19920, split out so that its fix closes its own ticket. You need a fork, Node and the dev server (`npm run server-start`); no Agent OS, Docker or AI tooling.

A headless sweep of every example page on 2026-10-20 found `examples/calendar/weekview` throwing during construction and rendering nothing. It still does on `dev` `f5decee2c0`. Open `http://localhost:8080/examples/calendar/weekview/index.html` and the console shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'setDate')`. The page fails the same way at `13.2.0`, so this predates 13.3.

## The Problem

The stack runs from `src/calendar/view/week/Component.mjs:837` (`date.setDate(...)`), up through `updateHeader` (defined at `:958`), to `construct` (`:257`), which calls `updateHeader(true, ...)`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `currentDate` arrives through `bind` (`:43`) from the calendar's state provider.
- A bound config is set after construction, so code inside `construct` still sees its default, `null`.

## The Fix

The likely cause, which the fix confirms or corrects: `construct` builds the header before the bound `currentDate` exists. Let the header wait for the date, or skip building it while the date is `null`, for example by building it when `currentDate` arrives.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `examples/calendar/weekview` loads with no page error and renders the week view.
- [ ] AC-2: a unit test in `test/playwright/unit/` fails before the fix and passes after it.

## Out of Scope

- The other rows of #19920, which have their own tickets.
